title: afterdark
profTagline: One live techno stream behind a full-screen WebGL rave, with real 3D rigged dancers locked to the beat — each moving to her own dance. Eleven dancers, a trio on stage, a night that never lightens, tilt for parallax.
installDesc: Opens like an app, straight into the rave
